name: opencode-tailor
description: OpenCode plugin that tailors a project's opencode.jsonc and agent set: one job per agent, explicit anti-jobs, verification, no leftover tools.

scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run test
scripts.smoke: bun -e "import('./src/index.ts').then((m) => { if (!m.default?.id || typeof m.default.setup !== 'function') throw new Error('missing V2 plugin export') })"
scripts.prepack: bun run check && bun run smoke
